description: Sends a transfer booking inquiry to the Platinumride team. Requires a route slug, the customer's name, a WhatsApp number (E.164) or email, a travel date today or later, passenger count and agreement to the Terms of Service (https://platinumride.com/terms). Returns an inquiry reference, the indicative 'from' price for the chosen vehicle tier and a WhatsApp follow-up link. Not a confirmed booking: the team confirms availability and the final price.

agreedToTerms.description: Whether the customer has read and agreed to the Terms of Service at https://platinumride.com/terms. Must be true.

customerEmail.description: Customer email address. At least one email or WhatsApp number is required.

customerWhatsApp.description: Customer WhatsApp number in E.164 format, e.g. '+971501234567'. At least one WhatsApp number or email is required.

date.description: Travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format, today or later in UAE time.

notes.description: Additional trip details for the Platinumride team.

pickupAddress.description: Pickup address, hotel or airport, optionally including a flight number.

vehicleTier.description: Optional vehicle tier name available on the route, e.g. 'Premium SUV'. Matching is case-insensitive.

name: create_inquiry
title: Send a booking inquiry
